ideas.title: Large-Scale Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of the fraud scheme involving dozens of individuals operating multiple companies to bill Minnesota Medicaid.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to identify all parties involved and determine the financial losses to the state.
questions: What is the total amount of financial losses?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable.

ideas.title: FBI Investigation into ICE Agents
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged kidnapping and burglary by ICE agents in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Determine the facts of the case and identify any wrongdoing by the ICE agents.
questions: What are the facts of the case?
Were the ICE agents involved in wrongdoing?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on law enforcement accountability and potential misconduct.
